observation: GSE120575 (16,291 cells): 1 cell positive for >=2 of 3 specific granule markers (CEACAM8/MPO/ELANE) vs ~0.14 expected by chance under independence; 0 positive for all 3. GSE72056 (4,645 cells): 25 cells positive for >=2 specific markers, of which 19 carry a confident alternative identity from the original authors' independent annotation (12 T cells, 2 macrophages, 5 malignant) and 4 are non-malignant-and-unassigned; 2 of those 4 share patient/well/sequencing-index (apparent duplicate), leaving 3 distinct candidates drawn from only 2 patients.
interpretation: GSE120575's signal is statistically indistinguishable from ambient/technical noise. GSE72056's 3-4 unassigned non-malignant candidates are genuinely consistent with neutrophil identity and are NOT dismissed as noise. What both datasets share is that the recoverable number is negligible (single digits), insufficient to define or map a cell state by any method.
biological_hypothesis: CD45+ FACS sorting followed by Smart-seq2 plate-picking depletes neutrophils to near-completeness, despite neutrophils being CD45+ and so not excluded by the sort gate itself; loss is attributable to downstream handling (dissociation, plate-picking, cryopreservation in GSE120575) rather than absence from the tumours.
clinical_implication: None directly (data-availability finding, not a biological claim about melanoma); establishes that single-cell neutrophil-state biology (H3) cannot be assessed from these public datasets.
suggested_validation: Not applicable to this finding (concerns data availability, not tissue biology). See 08_experimental_translation for assessment via a non-excluding protocol (fixed-cell chemistry, or flow cytometry which does not depend on transcript recovery).
justification: Consistent direction across 2 independent, independently-processed datasets (different labs, years, normalization pipelines) plus concordance with published characterisation of neutrophil loss in scRNA-seq. NOTE: 2 of the rubric's 4 Strong criteria (patient-level statistics, multiple-testing correction) were written for the differential-expression claims in H1-H5 and do not meaningfully apply to an existence/absence claim; this mismatch is stated explicitly rather than assumed away. Replication used dataset-appropriate methods rather than an identical test, because absolute TPM thresholds were found not to transfer between the two datasets (~100x base-rate difference) - itself a secondary methodological finding recorded in REPRODUCIBILITY.md. A prior version of this entry incorrectly stated zero candidates were non-malignant-and-unassigned; corrected 2026-08-01 following audit, see CHANGELOG.md.

observation: Unbiased discovery screen of 35 secreted chemokine/cytokine/growth-factor genes (GO-sourced panel, 327 candidates, 292 excluded by pre-specified detection filter), GSE120575, 19 pre-treatment patients (10 non-responder/9 responder), patient-level pseudobulk, limma. 4 genes significant at FDR<0.05: LTB (logFC -0.72, FDR 0.00025, higher in responders), CCL3 (+0.75, FDR 0.047), CCL4 (+0.73, FDR 0.047), CXCL13 (+0.86, FDR 0.047), all higher in non-responders except LTB. 9 significant at FDR<0.10.
interpretation: LTB's direction (higher in responders) is concordant with published tertiary lymphoid structure (TLS) biology, a favourable but not confirmatory sanity signal. CXCL13 runs opposite to LTB despite canonical association with the same TLS/B-cell-follicular axis in the literature -- flagged as an unresolved tension, not smoothed over; may reflect a different cellular source, addressable by H2/H4, not by bulk pseudobulk alone.
biological_hypothesis: A tumour-derived (CD45+ immune-compartment, see 01_compartment_audit.R) recruitment/lymphoid-organisation signalling programme differs between ICB responders and non-responders in melanoma, detectable pre-treatment.
clinical_implication: None stated yet -- premature ahead of H2 (cellular source), H4 (communication network) and H5 (independent-cohort validation), which this finding is carried into.
suggested_validation: Deferred to 08_experimental_translation until the full body of evidence (H2/H4/H5) is available to evaluate together.
justification: Patient-level statistics and BH multiple-testing correction satisfied; top finding concordant with an independent published mechanism (TLS/LTB). Capped at Moderate, not Strong, because H1 has no cross-dataset replication of its own -- GSE72056 was scoped to H0 replication only (see CHANGELOG.md); external validation is explicitly H5's role via the Hugo/Riaz bulk cohorts, not a gap in this module. Real, stated limitations: therapy-type confound not adjustable at n=19 (anti-PD1 monotherapy skews non-responder 8/12, anti-CTLA4+PD1 combo skews responder 4/5); substantial panel attrition (89% of the 327-gene panel excluded by a pre-specified, not post-hoc, detection filter) reflecting genuine Smart-seq2 sensitivity limits in a T-cell-dominated (69%) whole-sample pseudobulk.
